title: finding(types/plugin-ai): `AIInsightsSchema` is a declared node type that NOTHING registers — the `ai-insights` spelling has no renderer at all
body:
## 维护者速读

平台的类型声明里有一个组件叫 `ai-insights`(AI 洞察)。**这个仓里没有任何东西能把它画出来。** 作者(或读 `.d.ts` 的 AI)看到它是合法的组件类型,写下去,类型检查是绿的,运行时画出来的是一个红框:`Unknown component type: ai-insights`。

⭐ 本席今天复测了这条读数(原卡明确标注它是转述、⛔ 未复核):`ai-insights` 这个拼法在 `packages/**` 与 `apps/**` 里**只出现一次** —— 就在它自己的声明里。没有注册、没有渲染器、没有任何语料在写它。带同仪器的起爆对照(同样的查法能找出真实注册 `detail-view`)与缺失词对照(0 命中),所以这个零是读数,⛔ 不是空查询。

⚠️ 一个和原卡假设不同的事实:失败是**响亮的,不是静默的** —— 红框。所以这不是「悄悄吞掉」那一类事故,而是「声明面把人引向一个必然报错的拼法」。紧急度因此低,但它仍然是一条对不上的契约。

三个选择:

- **A —— 退役这个声明**:把 `AIInsightsSchema` 和 `ai-insights` 从已发布的类型面上删掉。声明面从此只列真能画出来的组件,写错在类型检查阶段就被拦下,不用等运行时。代价是动一处已发布类型面(按 #8178 的先例要走契约复核)。
- **B —— 补一个渲染器,把声明兑现**:让 `ai-insights` 真的能画。代价是给一个今天没有任何人要求的功能面投产能 —— 而「有没有人要」这件事⛔ 没人量过,这一条只有你能答。
- **C —— 留着,写明它是有意的前向声明**:文档块说清「这是为未来预留的,今天不可用」,并加一道门禁把它记为在册例外。代价是永久保留一个「声明了但画不出来」的特例,而它今天的表现就是那个红框。

我的建议是 **A**(回退:**C**)。**B 不该由我推荐** —— 要不要做 AI 洞察这个功能是产品决定,不是契约整理。

选哪个:A / B / C?

os-decision-facets

- ① 项目长远合理性:A 缩小声明面;C 把一个特例永久化并要养一道门禁;B 新增一整个功能面。这一轴上 A 最省,C 次之。
- ② 实际业务拉动:今天零人撞上(零语料、零注册,实测);拉动来自声明面本身 —— 它是 AI 写元数据时的说明书,里面每多一个画不出来的名字,AI 就多一条必然失败的候选。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:今天的失败已经是响亮的(红框),所以这一轴不指向紧急;但响亮的失败发生在**运行时**,而 A 把同一个错误提前到**写的时候**。越早拒绝越好,这是 A 相对 C 的全部优势。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:每一个已声明的键都是永久义务 —— remove 优于 declare-and-maintain。一个没有实现、没有语料、没有需求记录的声明,是这条规则最干净的适用对象。
- 推荐:**A**(回退:**C**)。
- 本分析看不见什么:我看不见客户应用或已发布文档里有没有人在写 `type: 'ai-insights'`(语料没有枚举,只量了本仓的 `packages` 与 `apps`);也看不见这个声明背后有没有一个未上线的产品计划 —— 产品意图不在代码里,只有你知道。这两点任一成立,答案就从 A 翻向 C 或 B。

## Re-measured 2026-09-15T07:51Z by the `domain:spec` @ objectui PM seat — the card's central reading, re-derived with controls

The card states that the registration absence is the dev seat's reading, ⛔ not re-derived by the filing seat, and asks for a re-measurement with a firing control before anyone acts on it. Taken now, on `origin/main` at `88561fdc48`:

| reading | result |
|---|---|
| occurrences of the spelling `ai-insights` under `packages/**` + `apps/**` | **exactly 1** — the `type` literal inside the declaration itself, in `packages/types/src/ai.ts` |
| any `ComponentRegistry.register` of that spelling | **none** |
| firing control, same instrument | the same query shape resolves a real registration of `detail-view` in `packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx` — the zero is a reading, ⛔ not a dead query |
| absent-token control on the same tree | `qqzz_absent_token_9999` → **0 files** |
| where `AIInsightsSchema` lives | declared in `packages/types/src/ai.ts`, re-exported from the package barrel `packages/types/src/index.ts` ⇒ it is on the **published** type surface |
| its only other occurrence | objectui#8178's retirement pin, which names `AIInsightsSchema.objectName` as deliberately NOT retired |
| a zod mirror for it | ⚠️ none found in the same sweep — the declaration is TS-only |

⇒ the dev seat's reading **holds**, and it is now this seat's reading too.

### What an author actually sees — the fact the card was missing

`SchemaRenderer` renders an unregistered type as a visible box reading `Unknown component type:` followed by the spelling (in `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx`, pinned by that package's `SchemaRenderer.unknownTypeCaseSuggestion.test.tsx` and `SchemaRenderer.primitiveSchema.test.tsx`).

⇒ the failure mode is **loud, not silent**. A node authored as `ai-insights` type-checks green against the published `.d.ts` and then renders an error box at runtime. That changes the pricing in both directions: this is ⛔ not a silent-swallow defect (so it is not urgent), but it *is* a published declaration that routes an author — or an AI reading the `.d.ts` as its authoring manual — to a spelling guaranteed to fail.

### ⛔ Still not measured

- Whether any document, example or customer application authors `type: 'ai-insights'`. Only this repository's `packages/**` and `apps/**` were enumerated; the schema corpus and anything outside this repository were not.
- Whether the declaration is a forward declaration for unshipped work. Product intent is not in the code, and ⛔ this seat will not guess it.
- objectui#8410's screening defect (non-metadata keys spread into React props) was ⛔ still not applied here — as the card says, that instrument is about *members* and this is a *type*, so it is likely the wrong instrument, but it remains unrun.

Filed unassigned by the `domain:spec@objectui` PM seat (session `session_01Jmxdo7bmeqCQHLSfmLVX9w`), from the `os-dev` report on objectui#8178. ⛔ Not claiming. Grading and `domain:*` are the triage seat's.

Filed because the reporting seat recorded **"Carrier: none today"** — a real observation with no successor reader is exactly what gets lost, and objectstack#17091 now requires a residual to get its own card rather than living in a report.

## The observation

`AIInsightsSchema` is declared in `@object-ui/types`, but **nothing in this repo registers the `ai-insights` type**, so no node of that spelling ever reaches a renderer.

⚠️ **This is a DIFFERENT shape from objectui#8178**, and the distinction is the point:

| | objectui#8178 | this card |
|---|---|---|
| the type | registered and rendered | **not registered at all** |
| the defect | individual members declared, advertised in the designer, read by nothing | the **whole node type** is declared and unrenderable |

⇒ #8178's ruling (batch #78, Remove) does **not** reach this, and the implementing seat correctly left `AIInsightsSchema.objectName` untouched and pinned — the ruling names three schemas and this is a fourth.

## ⛔ What has NOT been established — read this before pricing it

This is an **unscreened observation**, deliberately filed as one:

- ⛔ **Never screened** against objectui#8410's defect — that "no `schema.KEY` read site" does not imply inert, because `SchemaRenderer.tsx:1576` spreads non-metadata keys into React props. ⚠️ That screen is about *members*, and this card is about a *type*, so it may not even be the right instrument — but nothing has checked.
- ⛔ **Never priced, never ruled.** There is no batch-#78-style ruling covering it.
- ⛔ **The registration absence is the dev seat's reading, not re-derived by this seat.** Re-measure it before acting, with a firing control (a type that IS registered, resolving through the same instrument).
- ⚠️ Whether it is even a defect is open: a declared-but-unregistered type may be an intentional forward declaration, a stranded artifact, or an ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove instance. Those have different fixes and different blast radii.

⚠️ Note the sibling shape already on the board: objectui#8499 armed seven **registered** renderers that no `AnyComponentSchema` arm named — the *opposite* direction (registered but undeclared). This card is declared but unregistered. The two together are the two halves of the same registry-vs-declaration gap, and objectui#8499's PR measured **505 registered keys with no arm** on the other side.

## Appetite, if it turns out to be one

Establish which of the three explanations holds, with a measurement rather than an opinion — then it is either a retirement card (ADR-0049 shape, and per objectui#8178's precedent a retirement from a published `.d.ts` is `Clause-②: yes`), a registration card, or a documented forward declaration.

⛔ Falls off the back: anything about the three schemas objectui#8178 ruled on.

Refs: objectui#8178 (the ruling that stopped at three schemas) · PR #8796 · objectui#8499 (the opposite direction) · objectui#8410 (the screening defect)
